doc: Population standard deviation (ddof 0) over longitude of the first and the last row, as (north, south). ndarray.std on float32 accumulates in float32 (observed 5e-8 relative against float64); the tolerance is the float32 default. North row alternating 0/1 (std exactly 0.5), south row constant (std exactly 0 for a power-of-two width: the float32 mean of 64 equal values is exact).
